text_block_list.text:
After training, Sounds of Earth was 
playing a tune to soothe his own fatigue.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Benissimo! A soothing aria played at this 
hour is truly extraordinary."

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
La~ la~ la la la~ la la la~♪ La~~ la~~ la 
la la~♪

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hold on, Turbo, I get how you feel, but if 
you sing, you'll distract Earth from 
playing...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: La-la-la~ la~ la~♪ La-la~ la-la~ la~♪

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. If everyone's getting into it... How 
about this?!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, it's 'Soshiteminnano'! We all sang 
that together the other day! Come sing 
with us too, Nature!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huh!? ...Wait a sec! M... Me too!?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo and Company
text_block_list.text:
No matter how many times, again and 
againâª It feels like it's within reach 
right now~âª

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone looks so full of energy, having 
so much fun! Fufu, maybe I'll join in 
too."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, may I go? To train with everyone 
else.
choice_data_list: You should go for a run together.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Hey everyone~! Let me join in too! 
Accelerando!

Riding high on their soaring spirits, the 
four of them spent the rest of the day 
completely immersed in training.

I persuaded her that no matter how excited 
she felt, doing any more would be 
overtraining.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Sì. If that is your judgment, then it must 
be so.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Well then, for Turbo and the others, shall 
I play a piece to heighten their 
concentration?
